# Fixtures

Shared, **secret-free** test data. Nothing in this tree may contain a production
credential, bot token, HMAC secret, or supplier API key.

## Categories

- `telegram/` — raw Telegram update payloads (start, callback, search text).
- `vietqr/` — expected QR payload strings and CRC vectors.
- `sepay/` — signed webhook bodies + headers. Signatures are computed with the
  **test** HMAC secret `test-sepay-hmac-secret-do-not-use-in-prod` so that
  `tests/contract/sepay-webhook.test.ts` can verify integrity deterministically.
- `supplier/` — success / reject / unknown / malformed-asset responses. Asset
  "secrets" here are obvious fakes (e.g. `FAKE-KEY-0001`).
- `catalog/` — seed rows: one local-stock variant, one supplier-only variant, one
  unauthorized (no resale evidence) variant, one final-unit concurrency case.

## Signing helper

SePay fixtures are (re)generated by `tests/fixtures/sepay/sign.ts`, which reads the
test secret above. Never point that helper at a real secret.
